Actor.description: The actor of a session or an event.

ActorKind.description: Whether the actor is a person or a program acting on its own.

oneOf.description: A person at a terminal or an editor.

ActorName.description:
What the actor is called: a tool name such as `claude-code`, or a person's
handle. Never a credential.

EnvId.description:
Identifies one materialisation of a unit. A unit re-materialised after reclaim
gets a new environment, not a new unit.

SessionId.description: Identifies one attachment of an actor to an environment.

Timestamp.description: A UTC instant, serialised as an RFC 3339 string.

description:
One shell, agent or editor attached to a home directory. Sessions are what makes
"who is in this unit right now" answerable without guessing from processes.

ended_at.description: When it detached; absent while the session is open.

environment_id.description: The environment the actor attached to.

pid.description: Process id on the session's host, for attribution and idle detection.

title: Session
